name: China Motor Corporation
summary: China Motor Corporation manufactures and sells automobiles, and related parts and components in Taiwan and internationally. The company operates through Vehicle Manufacturing, Channel, and Others segments. It offers commercial and recreational vehicles, electric motorcycle, automated guided vehicle, sedan, RV, LCV, Truck, EV, and electric scooter. The company also engages in overseas investment in production and service industries; manufacture of automobile engine; provision of after-sales services of vehicle; consulting and servicing, and investment activities; automatic control equipment engineering; and sale of second-hand vehicle, motorcycle, bicycle, and parts.
